desc: Parse input: N, M, Sx, Sy; read N house points; read M commands.
Build dictionaries `y_to_xs` (y -> sorted list of x) and `x_to_ys` (x -> sorted list of y).
Initialize `visited = set()`, `cnt = 0`, current position `(x, y) = (Sx, Sy)`.
Compute new position `(nx, ny)` based on direction.
If D is horizontal ('L'/'R'): use `y_to_xs` with range `[min(x,nx), max(x,nx)]` via bisect, add new house coordinates to `visited`, increment `cnt`.
If D is vertical ('U'/'D'): use `x_to_ys` with range `[min(y,ny), max(y,ny)]` via bisect, add new house coordinates to `visited`, increment `cnt`.
After all commands, print `x y cnt`.
Ensure correct handling of 64-bit integers (Python int), use `bisect_left`/`bisect_right` from `bisect`, and handle empty maps gracefully.
